stack: Next.js 16 (SSG + daily revalidate) + React 19 + TS + Tailwind 4 + Zustand; View Transitions for re-shelving
macrostructure: Data shelf: headline with counted facts, an interactive bookcase with a catalogue card for the book in hand, sections as a table with bars; section, book and my-shelf pages
nav: N1 wordmark with spine mark, three links with a saved-count badge, theme switch
footer: Ft data source and freshness note
theme: custom: bookshop wall. Quiet sage wall, dark green bookcase, six book-cloth colours by family, paper objects constant across themes (design.md)
type: Literata (titles, text) + Sofia Sans Condensed (signage, spines) + Courier Prime (shelfmarks)
enrichment: The data itself: 158 spines whose thickness is weeks on the list (sqrt scale with a visible key); real covers from the list's own image host
motion: spines stand up on first load, lift on hover, stay lifted when picked, slide to new places on re-arrange. Reduced-motion safe.
verification: tsc + eslint clean; next build clean (248 static pages); 77/77 checks on the production server: no sideways scroll at 320-1440 on six routes, console clean, AA contrast on every route in both themes, keyboard (single tab stop, arrows, visible focus), arrange/filter/save flows, reduced motion, no-JS content, 404
critique: P5 H4 E4 S5 R4 V5
note: First pass: bookshop wall with six cloth colours. Rejected the same day as too close to the portfolio's eighties palette.

theme: custom: the stacks, automated. Dark instrument, books as slabs in a storage rack, one flat signal light per family (coral, azure, amber, lime, violet, cyan) on a deep tint, lime system accent. Dark by default; machines stay dark in the light theme. No glow, blur or colour gradients.
type: Michroma (display) + Sofia Sans / Sofia Sans Condensed (text, slabs) + JetBrains Mono (readouts)
motion: unchanged in kind: rack fills on load, slabs eject, View Transitions on re-arrange
critique: P5 H4 E4 S5 R4 V5
